error.name: PayeeMismatch
error.sentence: T2011001234567 = 株式会社メイギ商事 pays 0x9B4f…47e4; this invoice asked for 0xdCa5…6d5b.

explanation.text: The payment was refused on-chain because there is a mismatch between the registered payout for 株式会社メイギ商事 (T-number T2011001234567) at 0x9B4fc8994FcF2d5FE08a82A9454B61AA14D647e4 and the requested payment address 0xdCa52b5FA181a3307eCa852935BD40e3E0096d5b for the amount of ¥132,000. Furthermore, the system placed a triage hold due to the payee change request. Please confirm any new payment details with the supplier using contact details already on file.
